body:
## Scope

SC-00C keeps the compact left Library and opens a responsive expanded Spatial Library over the mounted Studio. Both sizes share one paged catalog, selection, SC-01 lifecycle actions, saved-content mutations and Harborlight permissions. Source, Show, Sort and the Scene Environment filter sit in a compact row above the expanded desktop gallery; phones use Filters. Selected owned content shows the same private, review-pending or Community-listed status in both sizes.

Place in Scene returns to the viewport for an explicit surface choice. A live attempt token rejects late ASSET_INSERT responses after Cancel or Scene replacement. The existing full-volume planner handles saved physical models at their resolved rendered scale for keyboard search and exact pointer placement. Single physical roots retain animation; physical assemblies with additional parts fail visibly for reviewed placement without changing the Scene. Schematic root animation is rebased after surface reanchoring. The canonical ASSET_INSERT service retains immutable version, lineage, license and conflict authority.

The SC-00C product merge source is 9a4eebe5145e1734526fa5d7e4f73e53a888e7fd, incorporating SC-07A draft PR #736 at 4680e62cd88af716acfc6ce2a0bd139db3735da7. Current PR head bc9c3bdee3f64373b2950fa212604dfb49067910 adds only the source-bound acceptance audit and evidence navigation. It resolves only three textual conflicts (.gitattributes, CHANGELOG.md and current-status.md) while retaining both branches. Parallax root PR #722 separately carries the SC-00C product source. Sixteen relevant Library, Studio, catalog, placement, publishing and browser-spec files are byte-identical to the local three-way rehearsal 8f1e87ac25602b9bf2291e73c0174eddc11509ad. That rehearsal is not a protected merge.

## Source-bound proof

- Exact local rehearsal 8f1e87ac25602b9bf2291e73c0174eddc11509ad: production Chromium passed 16 expanded Library and SC-07A publishing journeys, a separate 1/1 2,000-Scene paging case, and four compact Library and drag-placement cases. The independent focused media review found no remaining blocker in the repaired unassociated-Scene publishing explanation. These results are bound to the local three-way source, not to this PR head or protected main.

- Earlier combined browser source 8840a4bc2c09a92f5fe61ae9f8a6b9935da99f0f: production Chromium Library/Community 15/15 and lifecycle/drag 11/11 on separate fresh databases, plus a separate 1/1 2,000-Scene scale run. These receipts stay bound to that source. The scale run recorded 48/96 paged cards, one selected detail read, zero gallery canvases, no horizontal overflow at 390 px and a 6,626,373-byte whole-Studio bootstrap.
- Bounded placement product sources c5b977c81f757355783f0f32100d32333f380905 and 9491faf6a6183fc27c79d6aeb98a844d3256e503: 79/79 focused tests across five suites, typecheck and targeted ESLint pass. Two immutable independent source-only reports mark scale, mixed assembly, root animation and keyboard caller findings source-resolved within their reviewed scope.
- Final browser test source 7ac7594e665ef1a3d2c5e2c4bf33c0133139ce65: one fresh isolated production Chromium run passes 3/3 for delayed Cancel/private placement, licensed installed Asset reuse and scaled physical keyboard/pointer placement with rendered root timeline motion. Capture and cleanup pass. The first scaled browser fixture failed because its original Scene object occupied the tiny table; that receipt is preserved separately from the corrected passing run.
- Product merge source 9a4eebe5145e1734526fa5d7e4f73e53a888e7fd and docs-only PR head bc9c3bdee3f64373b2950fa212604dfb49067910 are mergeable against the current SC-07A base. Full TypeScript, targeted ESLint, documentation validation, Feature Catalog sync and validation pass on the reconciled source. A local standard build did not finish: Turbopack first rejected a temporary dependency junction, then failed with Windows OS error 1450 while reading an unrelated archived video after local dependencies were installed. This is retained as an environment-limited build attempt, not a passing build or product failure. The Feature Catalog remains unchanged because this is an unaccepted draft capability.

Receipts, original logs, native screenshots, recordings, failed fixture and independent source reports are indexed at Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-00c/20261015-expanded-library/README.md. The current requirement and gate mapping is in Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/SC_00C_Acceptance_Audit_20261015.md.

The archived Community video originally labeled installed-asset-placement.webm is the publisher context. The exact 7ac installer-context video was recovered byte-identically as asset-installer.original.webm, with its source path, SHA-256, UTC creation time and native installed/reused screenshots documented in the evidence index. The original publisher recording remains intact.

## Parallax root handoff and exact-source browser proof

Published handoff branch `codex/sc00c-root-rehearsal-20261016` at docs-only head `352c4546d` retains exact product/test source `d2b59c98cbd2eaa06541d2687a090e8a03533255`. That source merges this PR's current `a4fd2da9fabbd6c1d9dec7d836ed451ccf843abc` with Parallax root PR #722 head `325a0c5d2f37ee975d16527960048815ee8edcf9`; one current-status document conflict was reconciled. The expanded Library component and styles are unchanged from this PR head. On exact d2, a fresh isolated production Chromium suite passes **27/27** Library, placement, lifecycle and Community cases, and a separate fresh database passes **1/1** 2,000-Scene scale case. Production builds, capture and task-owned cleanup pass for both. Source-bound original logs, receipts, SHA-256 manifest and inspected desktop/narrow/phone/light/reduced-motion, placement and scale captures are in the [handoff evidence record](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/352c4546d/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-00c/20261016-root-rehearsal-d2b59c98/README.md). This is local browser proof on the combined branch, not protected Product Experience qualification or owner acceptance; PR #739 remains the SC-00C/SC-07A dependent draft.
## Current SC-07A reconciliation

SC-00C draft head `a4fd2da9fabbd6c1d9dec7d836ed451ccf843abc` merges SC-07A PR #736 head `9c6de12a34f7391607eb26df37752dcdc82c60ed`. The new SC-07A selected-source label and its exact-source browser receipt are retained. Three documentation conflicts were reconciled without changing the Library controls; Source, Show, Sort and contextual filters remain in the slim toolbar above the expanded desktop gallery. On this merged head, `docs:index`, `docs:validate`, `features:sync`, `features:validate`, `typecheck`, and the 20 focused SpatialContentLibrary component tests pass. No new exact-head production browser or protected qualification is claimed. The local Parallax root rehearsal above also uses this SC-07A head.
## Open gates

Protected Product Experience qualification, protected integration, live photo and physical AR validation, device/network performance and owner acceptance remain open. Crossdeck PR #721 final candidate 87bb29391ee747d9738cc7f259c47f4343a7da89 did not pass protected Sounding Line run 38822426167: finite custody reservation exited with `fetch failed` before product verification, so the technical suites were skipped and main did not advance. The Crossdeck owner has authorization for one additional attempt and is preparing the required protected reconciliation; no second result exists yet. The local browser and source-review results do not authorize a main merge.
